label: AB2_hP72_192_m_j2kl-001
title: Disordered (Al,P)O$_{4}$-5 Framework Structure
comments:
This is a version of \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_hP72_184_d_4d_d-001}{AlPO$_{4}$-5} with aluminum and phophorous atoms reandomly placed on the metallic sites, changing the space group from polar $P6cc$ \#184 to centrosymmetric $P6/mcc$ \#192. We arbitarily label these sites as ``Al.'' 
 For information on similar structures see the \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{SiO$_{2}$ and AlPO$_{4}$ page}.
